Upper Text: [On Play] For each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards, all of your opponent's Digimon get -1000 DP for the turn. Then, you may play 1 [ShootingStarmon] from under your Tamers without paying the cost.
[When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
